```sql
WITH lake_county_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Lake County' AND border_type ILIKE 'county'
),
longest_road_in_lake_county AS (
  SELECT r.geometry
  FROM roads r
  JOIN lake_county_geom lcg
    ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry, lcg.geometry)
  ORDER BY ST_Length(r.geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast,
        (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_road_in_lake_county)
      ),
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast,
    (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_road_in_lake_county)
  )
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM slope_raster s
)
SELECT
  'longest road in Lake County, California' AS name,
  stats.mean AS slope
FROM slope_stats;
```
